name: IMOUTO ROUTE
source:
My brother.....I want you to be my boyfriend..... Suzumori Taishi behaves like his younger sister's boyfriend to protect her from his bad friend. Ironically, Miwa (younger sister) falls in love with her older brother.....

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ029725.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的兄弟……我想让你成为我的男朋友……铃森大志表现得像他妹妹的男朋友，以保护她免受坏朋友的伤害。讽刺的是，美轮（妹妹）爱上了她的哥哥……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ029725.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
